role: Pandu's younger wife; mother of Nakula and Sahadeva
look: About 22, gentle but determined. Lighter warm skin. Cream bodice and antariya with a teal border; a saffron uttariya over one shoulder; a long braid. Red thread, bindi, no gold.
sourceNotes: Princess of the Madras (Adi §124–125). The text says she resisted Pandu at his death (§125): nothing in her design suggests otherwise.
notes: Built from the pandu rig (same head construction and joint pivots; legs hidden under the antariya) by episodes/S01E02-kindama-curses-pandu/svg/make-women.py, concept C. All poses face right; mirror in the scene with flip. No gold: Pandu gave his wives' ornaments away (Adi §119).

facingByPose.turning-away: body right, head looking back left (mirrored head)
